dedupe_keys.name: fault2sha central apennines database and structuring active fault data for seismic hazard assessment

description: Fault2SHA Central Apennines database and structuring active fault data for seismic hazard assessment is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Joanna Faure Walker et al. We present a database of field data for active faults in the central Apennines, Italy, including trace, fault and main fault locations with activity and location certainties, and slip-rate, slip-vector and surface geometry data. Coverage: national (IT); published in 2021. Formats: Shapefile, GeoPackage, KML. The data are held in PANGAEA and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Size stated by the repository: 10 data points. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support multi-sector infrastructure risk and planning studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
